credit.credit-words: When We All Get to Heaven
WORDS: Eliza E. Hewitt, pub.1898. MUSIC: “Heaven”; Emily D. Wilson, pub.1898. Public Domain.

In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you. Jn. 14:2 Then we... shall be caught up together... to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord. 1 Th. 4:17
